channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Tech & Infrastructure, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Tech & Infrastructure, US, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 17 Aug 2026 (17 Aug to 23 Aug 2026).

  • Aspen Global Change Institute: Climate and Environment Data Stewardship Fellow
    Aspen Global Change Institute (AGCI), with Public Environmental Data Partners · deadline Closed 19 Aug 2026 · Anticipated salary USD 85,000 to 100,000, based on the general US market.
  • Collider: Program Manager (AI safety fieldbuilding, New York)
    Collider · deadline Closed 23 Aug 2026 · USD 150,000 to 180,000 base salary, plus health insurance, 401(k) and 20 days paid time off. The one-day in-person work trial is paid.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
